Card Q&A.a: This means that the effect prevents processing of "(perform XX on) stacked cards."For example, a "can't trash stacked cards" effect prevents trashing the top stacked cards by  (which trashes the top stacked cards) or similar effects, and it prevents trashing the bottom stacked cards by "trash a digivolution card" or similar effects.However, because the effect only prevents processing "(perform XX on) stacked cards," XX is still permitted to be performed on the Digimon itself, for instance by effects that tell you to "perform XX" on the Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: What exactly does a "can't (perform XX on) stacked cards" effect mean?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. A "by doing X" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. The conditions for this inherited effect require you to return the specified number of cards to the bottom of the deck.
Card Q&A.q: Can I return just 1 [Vemmon] to the bottom of the deck for the conditions of this card's inherited effect?

Card Q&A.a: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the attack declaration timing, it will make a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the counter timing or block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.
Card Q&A.q: What does "end the attack" mean, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, such attacks can be ended. "End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?

[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, you may play 1 [Vemmon] from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, by returning 2 [Vemmon] from this Digimon's digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck, end that attack.
